regions.name: Lee County
regions.model_scope: Lee County independent 2024–25 grade-school district models use exact NCES LEA 1201080 / FL-36 / FDOE 36 identities. All 78 audited pure lower profiles with positive or protected Fall grades 3–8 and explicit-zero grades 9–12 remain searchable. Original whole-percent School Grades Math and ELA achievement supports 78 schools in each separate Math, ELA and independently fitted Combined model. Same-year individual February lunch-status counts use their own school denominator. Published accountable FAST PM3, BEST/Access EOC and eligible FAA achievement retains full-year, home-zoned, ELL and exemption rules; Datafolio and percent-tested participation remain separate. High, mixed, primary, closed and unmatched scopes remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score denominators and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.
regions.map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Lee County source release.
